Features

Everything You Need to Thrive

Clinical-grade assessments combined with intuitive tracking — all stored privately on your device.

🧠

PHQ-9 Depression Screen

Complete the validated Patient Health Questionnaire to monitor your mood over time. Get instant scoring and watch your progress through clear trend charts.

Mental Health
💫

GAD-7 Anxiety Assessment

The gold-standard Generalized Anxiety Disorder scale, presented in a clean, stress-free interface. Reflect on the last two weeks and track patterns across sessions.

Stress & Anxiety
⚖️

BMI Calculator & Tracker

Log your Body Mass Index with both imperial and metric support. Scroll-wheel precision input makes entering measurements effortless and accurate.

Physical Health
📈

Trend Visualization

Beautiful line charts show your scores and BMI over time, helping you spot patterns and celebrate improvements across all three health dimensions.

Analytics
📋

Complete History Log

Every assessment is saved with its timestamp so you can review your full history at a glance. Share results with your healthcare provider at your next visit.

History
🔒

100% Private & Local

All your data lives on your device only. Nothing is transmitted to external servers, sold to advertisers, or shared with third parties. Your health is yours alone.

Privacy First
🔐

Your Data Never Leaves Your Device

MoodBMI was designed with privacy at its core. We collect only what you enter, store it locally, and give you full control to delete it at any time. No accounts required, no cloud syncing, no data sharing — ever.

🚫 No Third-Party Sharing 📵 No Ads 🗑️ Delete Anytime 📡 No Server Uploads
